# CPU configuration fixtures

`legacy_pretrain.json` and `legacy_sft.json` capture the relevant generated
configuration from the original entrypoints at commit `5a42368`. They were
created by running those files with distributed initialization mocked and
`run_trainer` intercepted before model construction. These are reference outputs,
not outputs generated by the refactored builders under test.

Both use `MOLMO_DATA_DIR=/tmp/trajvlm-test-data`, W&B project `test-project`
and entity `test-entity`. Enum values are serialized with `str()`.

Pretrain arguments: `--save_folder=/tmp/legacy-pretrain --max_duration=10
--pointing=0 --nlp=0 --pretrained_segmenter_path=none --no_compile
--run_name=legacy_pretrain`.

SFT arguments: `<fixture-checkpoint> molmo2 --save_folder=/tmp/legacy-sft
--no_compile`. Checkpoint selection is mocked to return the fixture directory.

`pretrain_checkpoint/config.yaml` contains only model metadata generated by
`build_model_cfg('qwen3_4b_instruct', pretrained_segmenter_path=None)`.
It contains no weights and is exclusively a CPU test/preview fixture. Its model
init paths are deliberately nonexistent. Do not use it as a training checkpoint.

The existing sampler/shape variable-length tuple annotations were corrected
before capture so OmegaConf 2.4 can serialize the unchanged configuration values.

`legacy_sft.json` was later updated by hand for two intended behaviour changes:
the SFT video preprocessor now samples `max_frames = num_frames` frames with
`uniform_last_frame` (previously the pretrain value of 8 frames at `fps`), and
`ssv2_qa` was enabled in `VIDEO_ACADEMIC_DATASETS`.
